rca of the issue: Original user complaint (patients seeing blocked slots) was due to the frontend not filtering blocked_sessions from the slot list in DoctorDetailModal.jsx - only full-day blocked_dates were greyed out. This iteration's fix (adding fetch of blocked_sessions + isInBlockedSession() filter at line 184-188/198 of DoctorDetailModal.jsx) is verified working end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend enforcement (assert_slot_not_blocked across 9 endpoints) was already validated in iterations 394-400.
